Measurement cycle
=========== 


A new sample is handled with the following steps:

### flush
Flush tubes with water from the active wiki:source for the time given 
in the properties of the source (flushtime). The flush water goes through water path A 
with wiki:devices/ysi600r and wiki:devices/tribox. Control of valves and pumps is done by wiki:devices/alphaValves
If a sample will be taken, move wiki:devices/samplerobot to the fridge.

### empty last / wait
If the reservoir is not empty, wait until the wiki:devices/cws isotope sampler can switch ports and empty the reservoir

### fill 1
Fill reservoir with water from the wiki:source

### empty 1
Empty reservoir the first time. If a sample is taken into the wiki:fridge, 
the water goes through the fridge waste port.

### fill 2
Fill reservoir again

### start cws
Start isotope measurement with continuous water sample (CoWS) (that is switch to Port 4)

### throughflow measurements
Pump water through water path A, start wiki:devices/ysi600r using output 1 of wiki:devices/alphaIO, to flush
YSI and ProPS (wiki:devices/tribox). Flush time can be changed at ??.   

Start averaged measurement of YSI probe and do ProPS measurement

### store sample in fridge
If the sample is stored in the wiki:fridge, move wiki:devices/samplerobot to next empty bottle and release water
from the reservoir into the bottle
